scope: Cloud-only original bounded CPU LoRA and saved-mask fixtures
not_validated: actual CUDA/PEFT dropout dispatch and routing

outcomes.name: lora_b_scale_add_custom_autograd_ownership
outcomes.decision: CPU supports B+scale+add ownership while retaining A/dropout and exact cast boundaries. This custom Function still runs ordinary Torch ops; no launch fusion or T4 feasibility measured.

outcomes.name: per_saved_native_dropout_mask_hooks
outcomes.decision: Per-saved-mask hooks preserve tested outputs/RNG/retained backward and leave neighboring saved tensors untouched. Skip known pre-mutation conflicts; propagate all pack failures. Actual PEFT/CUDA routing and memory benefit remain unvalidated.

outcomes.name: cpu_autocast_b_tail_contract
outcomes.decision: Installed CPU autocast F.linear agrees with explicit half-cast B-tail oracle in these fixtures; this does not prove CUDA autocast or actual PEFT dtype routing.
